When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tasiele Shan]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for challenging their views on [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] and attachment, she was sent to an '''unnamed planet''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in order to [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on her controversial views. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to retrieve her years later, all they found was Shan's cliffside dwelling and a set of journals written to her young [[Daughter/Legends|daughter]] [[Satele Shan|Satele]].
